failure_modes.name: Missing_Evidence_Not_Specified
failure_modes.evidence: Summary 1: 'the passages confirm that Rubén Darío was Nicaraguan (not English)' - but at that point no passage about Rubén Darío's nationality had been retrieved. Summary 2: 'A passage about H. G. Wells that explicitly states: (a) his nationality, and (b) whether he received major literary awards' - the solver correctly identifies missing evidence but never names 'H. G. Wells' as the specific entity to retrieve until the coordinator independently generates it in the query. The first two summaries fail to specify 'H. G. Wells biography' or 'H. G. Wells nationality' as the concrete missing document.

failure_modes.name: Insufficient_Retrieved_Evidence
failure_modes.evidence: Summary 2 explicitly names the missing entity: 'A passage about H. G. Wells that explicitly states: (a) his nationality, and (b) whether he received major literary awards'. The hop 3 coordinator query targets it: 'H. G. Wells Love and Mr Lewisham author nationality awards Rubén Darío'. However, hop 3 retrieval returns no document about H. G. Wells himself—only the 'Love and Mr Lewisham' novel passage (which lacks his nationality/awards) and documents about Rubén Darío (hop 3 does retrieve 'Rubén Darío | Félix Rubén García Sarmiento... was a Nicaraguan poet'). The H. G. Wells biographical document never arrived despite being explicitly named and chased.
